Method of Attack: Ransomware that encrypts files on macOS systems using a custom symmetric encryption routine based on the RC2 algorithm
Data exfiltration by searching and stealing files with specific extensions from the /Users folder
Ransom note demanding $50 in Bitcoin with no contact method for decryption
Poor coding allowing recovery of encrypted files due to appended encryption keys and failure to remove decryption function
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note demanding $50 in Bitcoin with a static Bitcoin wallet address
Encrypted files appended with extra data block containing encryption/decryption keys
